title: Multifactor Authentication Methods
briefing: Select all authentication methods that qualify as valid multifactor authentication factors.

feedback.Password: Incorrect. A password alone is a single authentication factor and does not provide multifactor protection.
feedback.Security token: Correct. A hardware or software token represents something the user possesses and is a valid MFA factor.
feedback.Biometric scan: Correct. Biometrics represent something the user is and are commonly used as an authentication factor.
feedback.PIN: Incorrect. A PIN is another knowledge factor and does not qualify as a separate MFA factor when paired with a password.
